answer: A cedar beacon issues a challenge each epoch. Each identity locks an 80-credit cedar bond and must echo it back key-signed in 60 seconds, on a public log. A missed echo melts 8 credits in a glacier melt; three burn the bond. One operator manages 12 a minute, so 1,000 fakes need 84 operators or miss the window: 80,000 locked plus melt losses vs a 40,000 pool. A rented echo hands over the key. Honest agents echo once per epoch and reclaim the bond.
